title: When to Replace a Mattress (And When to Refresh the Top)
seo_title: When to Replace a Mattress: Signs, Lifespan & Refresh Options
meta: Know the signs it is time to replace a mattress - sagging, heat, allergy irritants, poor support - and when refreshing a comfort layer is the smarter move.
excerpt: Most beds wear out from the top down. Learn the replacement signs - and why refreshing the comfort layer can beat binning the whole mattress.
